parts.name: Translation Panel (Right Sliding Glass)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding glass panel of the window, made primarily of glass with an aluminum or PVC frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open and close horizontally, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel (Left Sliding Glass)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding glass panel of the window, made of glass and framed with aluminum or PVC.
parts.Functional_description: It can slide horizontally to overlap with the right panel, allowing partial opening of the window.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally in the opposite direction of the right panel along the same track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the sliding window, made of aluminum for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and guides the sliding panels, providing structural integrity and sealing against the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the sliding panels.
